notes: Confirmed via HPE official datasheet (a00098249enw) and QuickSpecs (a50000620enw), cross-checked with B&H, CDW, and multiple Aruba-authorized resellers. 8x RJ-45 10/100/1000 ports all support Class 4 PoE+ (up to 30W each) within a 124W total budget; 2x SFP slots are 1GbE only (not SFP+/10G, per model naming "2SFP" and datasheet). No console/serial port exists on this model — Instant On switches are managed exclusively via the Instant On mobile app, cloud web portal, or local web GUI (no CLI/console port). Power: internal AC power supply with a detachable IEC C13/C14-style cord (region-specific plug end, e.g. NEMA 5-15 on US #ABA SKU) — modeled here as a single "iec" power input port representing the switch-side inlet, which is standard for this class of device. Physical form factor is compact desktop-style but ships with rack-mount ears (1U rack-mountable) per HPE documentation and reseller listings (CDW lists it as rack-mountable). No USB ports on this model.
